excerpt.zh:
我们在围绕着[From.GetName]的小行星中发现了一艘外星飞船在那里漂泊。它对我们的联络新号毫无反应。它到底是无法解析我们的信号，还是可能因为其他原因无视我们，我们无从得知。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]建议我们派遣一艘工程船来，将其拖出碎片区。要是不管它的话，这艘外星飞船很可能会被小行星撞碎。

已发布一项特殊项目去拯救飞船并调查它。
excerpt.en:
We have discovered an alien ship adrift among the asteroids surrounding [From.GetName]. It is not responding to our hailing signals. Whether this is due to it being unable to interpret our signal, or perhaps some other reason, we do not know.

texts.en:
We have discovered an alien ship adrift among the asteroids surrounding [From.GetName]. It is not responding to our hailing signals. Whether this is due to it being unable to interpret our signal, or perhaps some other reason, we do not know.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] recommends that a construction ship be dispatched to tow this stricken vessel out of the debris field. If left untouched, there is a risk the alien ship may be crushed by the asteroids.

A Special Project has been issued to rescue and investigate the ship.

texts.zh:
漂泊在[From.From.From.GetName]的飞船被拖拉出来，我们得以派遣特遣队去调查它。里面发生过一场谋杀。只找到了一位船员的尸体——那是一个长耳朵的两栖双腿生物，他身上有多处刺伤。该舰船因为没有了主人，已归我们所有。

该舰船拥有非常高效的推进器，它的架构和设计都高于我们当前的水准。飞船没有装备武器，看来是一艘运送重要人员的运输船。

把它改造成勘探船无需花费多大功夫。不过，如果我们拆毁它并仔细研究它的引擎，也许就能够对我们的舰队水平有实际提升。
texts.en:
Once the ship drifting by [From.From.From.GetName] was towed out of the debris, we were able to send in an away team to investigate. They uncovered a murder scene. Only one crew member has been found - a long-eared, amphibian biped who appears to have been stabbed repeatedly.

With its crew evidently dead, the ship is now up for grabs. It is fitted with very efficient thrusters, the structure and design of which are beyond us at present. The vessel is not armed, seemingly having been used as a transport for important personnel.

Repurposing it into an exploration vessel would be a minor undertaking. However, if we deconstruct it and study the engines in greater detail, we may instead be able to apply its ingenious design to our own fleets.

label.en: Repurpose it into a science vessel.
Tear it down and study the engines.

texts.zh: 很遗憾，未能抢救靠近[From.From.From.GetName]的漂流船。一个未侦测到的小行星突然出现在碰撞航向上，把那艘船撞成了碎片。
texts.en: Sadly we were not able to save the drifting ship close to [From.From.From.GetName] before it was too late. An untracked asteroid appeared on a collision course and smashed the ship to pieces.

label.zh: 极端唯物主义 · 唯物主义

texts.zh: 一艘外星飞船在小行星带中漂泊。它并没有回应呼叫。我们应该调查到底发生了什么。
texts.en: An alien ship is drifting inside an asteroid belt. It will not respond to hails. We should investigate and see what is going on.
